g.text: Plain labels + 1 px lines. No opaque price-zone fills. Selected count details stay off the candles.
Blue: larger degree Teal: child degree Amber dashed: primary path Violet dotted: alternate
This original mockup specifies layout only. Exact WaveBasis visual parity and predictive accuracy are unverified.
